notes: «وبهذا الإسناد» opens the report and is kept as a back_reference: the three reports before it (prev1 to prev3) carry no written chain, and prev4 writes a chain ending in Zayd b. Ali's own words, so how much is taken over is uncertain and the phrase stands as written
The Prophet's words to Fatima are the saying; Abu Sa'id is the last link
